name: Wit of the Stinging Geyser
body:
School conjuration (creation) [acid]; Level: jester 3

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action
Components: (not included in source material)

EFFECT

Range: Touch
Target: Creature touched
Duration: 1 round
Saving Throw: none; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

The target suffers 2d8 points of acid damage, plus an additional point for each caster level. The target also takes 5 points of acid damage at the start of its next turn.

For the duration of the combat, once per round when you score a critical hit against this target, you may move up to your speed after the attack is resolved.
